title: Composition of coefficient pullback and single-complex comparisons
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring and let T,Y,T₂,Y₂,T₁,Y₁ be schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with e:Y→T, π₂:T₂→T, a₂:Y₂→Y, e₂:Y₂→T₂, π₁:T₁→T₂, a₁:Y₁→Y₂ and e₁:Y₁→T₁, satisfying a₂≫e=e₂≫π₂ and a₁≫e₂=e₁≫π₁. Let F be an etale Λ-module sheaf on T [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. In the coefficient part of [sbc-def-base-change-map], write C₂:a₂^*e^*(F[0])→e₂^*((π₂^*F)[0]), C₁:a₁^*e₂^*((π₂^*F)[0])→e₁^*((π₁^*π₂^*F)[0]) and C₀:(a₁≫a₂)^*e^*(F[0])→e₁^*(((π₁≫π₂)^*F)[0]) for the composites of inverse pullback composition comparison, equality transport, forward composition comparison, and pullback/single-complex comparison. Then a₁^*(C₂) followed by C₁ and e₁^* of the degree-zero image of the inverse sheaf comparison π₁^*π₂^*F→(π₁≫π₂)^*F equals the inverse derived comparison a₁^*a₂^*e^*(F[0])→(a₁≫a₂)^*e^*(F[0]) followed by C₀. No direct-image transition or homology functor occurs in this statement.

source.place: canonical pullback restriction maps in the proof of condition (1); derived pullback composition, made explicit for exact module pullbacks

proof.text: Expand the three C maps. Apply the closed source theorem upperStarCompDerivedPlus_assoc to (a₁,a₂,e), (a₁,e₂,π₂), and (e₁,π₁,π₂), using the two commutativity witnesses for equality transport. Naturality moves the π₂ pullback/single-complex comparison through the (a₁,e₂) composition comparison. Cancel each intervening composition isomorphism against its inverse. The uncancelled source map is the inverse comparison for (a₁,a₂), and all other maps lie inside e₁^*.

The remaining identity is compatibility of the exact functors π₂^*, π₁^* with the single-complex functor and their composition comparison. Evaluate both maps on a complex supported in degree zero: at degree zero they are precisely the sheaf composition comparison; elsewhere they are the unique maps between zero objects. Map this equality through the homotopy quotient and localization using the defining factorization isomorphisms of mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor and upperStarPlusComp. The fully faithful inclusion D⁺→D reflects the equality. Applying e₁^* proves the displayed identity, including the final inverse sheaf composition comparison.
